title: FirstOntario Concert Hall

services.name: Suite Rentals
services.desc: Enjoy your next event from the comfort and convenience of your own private luxury suite at FirstOntario Concert Hall. Whether you're entertaining clients, celebrating a special occasion, or gathering with friends, family, or colleagues, a private suite offers an elevated way to experience live entertainment. Private suites are available for select FirstOntario Concert Hall events (excluding Hamilton Philharmonic Orchestra performances). To ensure a safe and efficient entry, only small bags and purses are permitted. Oversized bags, backpacks, and suitcases are not allowed. All bags are subject to inspection upon entry.
